NocturneWood_Text_Npc0.en: The trees here never sleep. Neither\ndo I.
NocturneWood_Text_Npc0.fr: Les arbres ici ne dorment jamais.\nMoi non plus.

NocturneWood_Text_Npc1.en: HOOTHOOT knows the time better than\nany clock.
NocturneWood_Text_Npc1.fr: HOOTHOOT connaît l'heure mieux que\nn'importe quelle horloge.

NocturneWood_Text_Quest0_Ask.en: Three ANTIDOTEs, young one. The\nwood bites back.
NocturneWood_Text_Quest0_Ask.fr: Trois ANTIDOTES. Le bois\nmord en retour.

NocturneWood_Text_Quest0_NoRoomT.en: Your BAG is full. Make room, then\ncome back.
NocturneWood_Text_Quest0_NoRoomT.fr: Ton SAC est plein. Fais de la\nplace, puis reviens.

NocturneWood_Text_ReturnAsk.en: Ready to go back to the dock?

NocturneWood_Text_Stay.en: Take your time. The tide can wait.
NocturneWood_Text_Stay.fr: Prends ton temps. La marée peut\nattendre.
